title: Conclusion's platform slots are filled by Mendix, OutSystems, SAP, Salesforce, Dynamics and AFAS
content:
Conclusion's tool field enumerates six platforms: Mendix, OutSystems, SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics and AFAS. Two of those are held through named vehicles — Conclusion Low Code Company for Mendix, and myAppX and myBrand for OutSystems — which is a stronger form of commitment than a partner badge. Its verticals are insurance, banking, healthcare and public.

The rank follows mechanically. This row was rescored on size and slot occupancy only, and Conclusion is the case that criterion was built to catch: the low-code slot in particular is doubly filled, by two competing proprietary platforms with organisational structure built around each. A component placed there would have to displace an established revenue line rather than fill a gap.

There is a tension worth recording, though. The row is marked do-not-pitch on the strength of that mechanical read while the flag simultaneously asks for an OSS-portfolio screen before acting. The exclusion and the outstanding evidence step sit in the same sentence, which means the tier should be treated as well-motivated but not yet verified.
